{{Top|leg}}
'''GA-60s double laser cannons''' were a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. They were used in [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]].
